description: NaNdTiNbO₆F crystallizes in the tetragonal P4_122 space group. Na is bonded to six O and two equivalent F atoms to form distorted NaO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with two equivalent NaO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with four equivalent NdO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.56-2.78 Å. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.21 Å. Nd is bonded to six O and two equivalent F atoms to form distorted NdO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with two equivalent NdO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with four equivalent NaO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.69 Å. Both Nd-F bond lengths are 2.32 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NbO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids, and edges with four equivalent NdO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-48°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.01 Å. Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NdO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids, and edges with four equivalent NaO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-45°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.02 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nd, one Ti, and one Nb atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nd, one Ti, and one Nb atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Nd and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Nb atoms to form distorted ONa₂Nb₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent FNa₂Nd₂ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one FNa₂Nd₂ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONa₂Nb₂ trigonal pyramids. F is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Nd atoms to form FNa₂Nd₂ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent FNa₂Nd₂ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₂Nb₂ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Nb₂ trigonal pyramid.
